fit_reason: These are two small rotomolded plastic whitewater kayaks with paddles and spray skirts. Polyethylene kayaks have no paint, gelcoat or interior that our car and boat detailing services work on, so this is not a vehicle we can detail.
findings: Bright, clean orange plastic on both kayak decks
Seats and outfitting in both cockpits look clean
Light scuffing and faint grime on the underside of one hull, normal for plastic whitewater boats and not something a detail changes
